```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo=FALSE, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE)
library(randomForest)
library(caret)
library(pROC)
set.seed(42)
```

Random forest (RF) models are fitted to the same three datasets and the same
80/20 train–test split (seed 42) as the earlier logistic-regression (LR) and KNN
analysis, so results are directly comparable.

- **Balanced** binary: 1 = diabetes, 0 = no diabetes / prediabetes.
- **Imbalanced** binary: 1 = prediabetes or diabetes, 0 = no diabetes.
- **3-class**: 0 = no diabetes, 1 = prediabetes, 2 = diabetes.

```{r data}
data.012=read.csv("data/diabetes_012_health_indicators_BRFSS2021.csv")
data.bal=read.csv("data/diabetes_binary_5050split_health_indicators_BRFSS2021.csv")
data.012$y.bin=as.numeric(data.012$Diabetes_012>0)
xvars=names(data.012)[-c(1,23,24)]   # 21 predictors

set.seed(42)
idx=createDataPartition(data.bal$Diabetes_binary,p=0.8,list=FALSE)
bal.tr=data.bal[idx,]; bal.te=data.bal[-idx,]
set.seed(42)
idx=createDataPartition(data.012$y.bin,p=0.8,list=FALSE)
imb.tr=data.012[idx,]; imb.te=data.012[-idx,]
cls.tr=data.012[idx,]; cls.te=data.012[-idx,]

metric.bin=function(truth,pred,prob){
  tp=sum(truth==1&pred==1); fp=sum(truth==0&pred==1)
  fn=sum(truth==1&pred==0); tn=sum(truth==0&pred==0)
  acc=(tp+tn)/length(truth)
  precision=tp/(tp+fp); recall=tp/(tp+fn); specificity=tn/(tn+fp)
  f1=2*precision*recall/(precision+recall)
  auc=as.numeric(roc(truth,prob,levels=c(0,1),direction="<",quiet=TRUE)$auc)
  c(accuracy=acc,precision=precision,recall=recall,specificity=specificity,f1=f1,auc=auc)
}
metric.cls=function(truth,pred){
  per=NULL
  for(cl in 0:2){
    tp=sum(truth==cl&pred==cl); fp=sum(truth!=cl&pred==cl); fn=sum(truth==cl&pred!=cl)
    prec=ifelse(tp+fp==0,0,tp/(tp+fp))
    rec=ifelse(tp+fn==0,0,tp/(tp+fn))
    f1=ifelse(prec+rec==0,0,2*prec*rec/(prec+rec))
    per=rbind(per,data.frame(class=cl,precision=prec,recall=rec,f1=f1))
  }
  list(accuracy=mean(truth==pred),per_class=per,macro_f1=mean(per$f1))
}

if(file.exists("rf_models.rds")){
  mods=readRDS("rf_models.rds")
  rf.bal=mods$rf.bal; rf.imb=mods$rf.imb; rf.cls=mods$rf.cls
}else{
  rf.bal=randomForest(x=bal.tr[,xvars],y=factor(bal.tr$Diabetes_binary),ntree=500,importance=TRUE)
  rf.imb=randomForest(x=imb.tr[,xvars],y=factor(imb.tr$y.bin),ntree=500,importance=TRUE)
  rf.cls=randomForest(x=cls.tr[,xvars],y=factor(cls.tr$Diabetes_012),ntree=500,importance=TRUE)
  saveRDS(list(rf.bal=rf.bal,rf.imb=rf.imb,rf.cls=rf.cls),"rf_models.rds")
}

p.rf.bal=predict(rf.bal,bal.te[,xvars],type="prob")[,"1"]
p.rf.imb=predict(rf.imb,imb.te[,xvars],type="prob")[,"1"]
m.bal.rf=metric.bin(bal.te$Diabetes_binary,as.numeric(p.rf.bal>0.5),p.rf.bal)
m.imb.rf=metric.bin(imb.te$y.bin,as.numeric(p.rf.imb>0.5),p.rf.imb)

p.rf.cls=predict(rf.cls,cls.te[,xvars],type="prob")
pred.rf.cls=as.numeric(colnames(p.rf.cls)[apply(p.rf.cls,1,which.max)])
truth.cls=cls.te$Diabetes_012
met.rf.cls=metric.cls(truth.cls,pred.rf.cls)
ovr_auc=sapply(0:2,function(cl) as.numeric(roc(as.numeric(truth.cls==cl),p.rf.cls[,cl+1],levels=c(0,1),direction="<",quiet=TRUE)$auc))
```

# Model parameters

Same hyperparameters for all three forests (defaults except `ntree` and
`importance`).

```{r params}
params=data.frame(
  Hyperparameter=c("Number of trees (ntree)","mtry (candidates per split)",
    "nodesize (min terminal-node size)","maxnodes (tree-depth limit)",
    "sampsize (bootstrap sample size)","replace (bootstrap resampling)",
    "Split criterion","importance","Type"),
  Setting=c(paste0(rf.bal$ntree),
    paste0(rf.bal$mtry,"  (default = floor(sqrt(21)))"),
    "1 (default)","none (fully grown trees)",
    "n (one bootstrap draw per tree, with replacement)",
    "TRUE (default)","Gini impurity","TRUE (permutation + Gini)","classification"),
  stringsAsFactors=FALSE)
params
```

# Prediction results

## Binary (balanced and imbalanced)

```{r binary}
bin.rf=data.frame(
  Dataset=c("Balanced","Imbalanced"),
  Accuracy=c(m.bal.rf["accuracy"],m.imb.rf["accuracy"]),
  Precision=c(m.bal.rf["precision"],m.imb.rf["precision"]),
  Recall=c(m.bal.rf["recall"],m.imb.rf["recall"]),
  Specificity=c(m.bal.rf["specificity"],m.imb.rf["specificity"]),
  F1=c(m.bal.rf["f1"],m.imb.rf["f1"]),
  AUC=c(m.bal.rf["auc"],m.imb.rf["auc"]))
bin.rf[,-1]=round(bin.rf[,-1],4)
bin.rf
```

## 3-class

```{r threeclass}
cls.rf=data.frame(
  Class=c("No diabetes (0)","Pre-diabetes (1)","Diabetes (2)"),
  Precision=met.rf.cls$per_class$precision,
  Recall=met.rf.cls$per_class$recall,
  F1=met.rf.cls$per_class$f1,
  `OVR AUC`=ovr_auc)
cls.rf[,-1]=round(cls.rf[,-1],4)
cls.rf
```

```{r threeclass_overall}
data.frame(Accuracy=round(met.rf.cls$accuracy,4),
           `Macro F1`=round(met.rf.cls$macro_f1,4),
           `Mean OVR AUC`=round(mean(ovr_auc),4))
```

# Comparison with LR and KNN

## Binary

```{r cmp_binary}
prev=read.csv("model_metrics.csv")
lr.knn=data.frame(model=prev$model,dataset=prev$dataset,accuracy=prev$accuracy,
  precision=prev$precision,recall=prev$sensitivity,F1=prev$F1,AUC=prev$AUC)
rf=data.frame(model="Random forest",dataset=c("Balanced","Imbalanced"),
  accuracy=c(m.bal.rf["accuracy"],m.imb.rf["accuracy"]),
  precision=c(m.bal.rf["precision"],m.imb.rf["precision"]),
  recall=c(m.bal.rf["recall"],m.imb.rf["recall"]),
  F1=c(m.bal.rf["f1"],m.imb.rf["f1"]),
  AUC=c(m.bal.rf["auc"],m.imb.rf["auc"]))
cmp=rbind(lr.knn,rf)
cmp[,-(1:2)]=round(cmp[,-(1:2)],4)
cmp
```

## 3-class

```{r cmp_threeclass}
prev3=read.csv("model_metrics_3class_overall.csv")
cmp3=rbind(
  data.frame(model=prev3$model,accuracy=prev3$accuracy,
             macro_F1=prev3$macro_F1,mean_OVR_AUC=prev3$mean_OVR_AUC),
  data.frame(model="Random forest",accuracy=met.rf.cls$accuracy,
             macro_F1=met.rf.cls$macro_f1,mean_OVR_AUC=mean(ovr_auc)))
cmp3[,-1]=round(cmp3[,-1],4)
cmp3
```

Random forest matches the ranking ability of LR and KNN on the binary tasks (AUC
around 0.79–0.81) and, unlike them, predicts a small non-zero share of the rare
prediabetes and diabetes classes in the 3-class task.
